# Best Areas to Stay in Pokhara, Nepal

## **Lakeside (Most Popular)**
- The main tourist hub along Phewa Lake
- Best for: restaurants, shops, nightlife, boat rentals
- Wide range of accommodations from budget to luxury
- Can be noisy and crowded

## **Lakeside North (Khahare)**
- Quieter end of Lakeside
- Still walkable to main attractions
- Better mountain views
- Good balance of convenience and peace

## **Damside (Pardi)**
- Southern end of the lake
- More local feel, less touristy
- Budget-friendly options
- Quieter but fewer amenities

## **Begnas/Rupa Lake Area**
- Outside the main town (30-40 min drive)
- Very peaceful, scenic
- Best for nature retreats
- Limited dining/shopping options

---

## Quick Recommendations:

| Traveler Type | Best Area |
|---------------|-----------|
| First-timers | Central Lakeside |
| Peace & quiet | Lakeside North |
| Budget travelers | Damside |
| Trekkers | Central Lakeside (easy gear shopping) |
| Luxury/retreat | Lakeside North or outskirts |

**Lakeside** is generally the safest choice for most visitors due to convenience, views, and walkability.
